{{Top|leg}}
The '''gravity slice''' was a type of weaponry used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces during the [[Battle of Mindor]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. The technology was developed in the [[Imperial weapons facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taspan II]].<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
